name_en: Tamil Nadu Marine Fisherwomen Savings-cum-Relief Scheme
department: Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: You save Rs 1,500: Rs 175 a month for 8 months and Rs 100 in the 9th month. The State Government adds Rs 3,000. You get Rs 4,500 in total during the 3 lean months.

other: You must work full time in fishing or fishing-related work.
You must be a member of a Fisherwomen Co-operative Society.
You must be Below Poverty Line (BPL).
If you or your family members have a regular job or other income, you cannot get this.

documents: Bank passbook first page copy (with photo)
Copy of enrolment through the e-Sevai centre
how_to_apply: Fill the application form. Attach your papers. You need to enrol through an e-Sevai centre.

evidence.quote: The beneficiary has to contribute Rs.1,500/- @ Rs.175/- per month for the first eight months and Rs.100/- on the ninth month.
The State Government will contribute Rs.3,000/-per fisherwomen, totalling a sum of Rs.4,500/- will be given as a relief to the fisherwomen during the lean period of 3 months.
